USDe.source: DeFiLlama (Ethena USDe page), Amsig Labs Stablecoin Revenue report
USDe.notes: DeFiLlama distinguishes 'Fees' (gross yield across all backing: staking rewards + yield distribution + mint fees + extra fees) from 'Revenue' (mint fees + staking-rewards portion routed to Ethena's Reserve Fund). Earlier drafts used Fees to estimate both Ethena's cut and staker payout; this was wrong on both counts, since Fees is neither. Revenue is used directly as Ethena's retained amount. Staker payout is calculated from staked sUSDe supply x APY instead, since Fees does not represent staker payout. susde_staked_usd and susde_apy_pct are snapshot figures from the report (17 Jul 2026), not live data, and this section does not scale with live USDe supply.
